description: Reviewed seed candidates generated from deterministic language-knowledge growth over the 146-entry corpus and invariance benchmark cases. This packet expands language anchors for pressures and operators while preserving belief movement at none. Integrated as extension_15.

entries.text: Repeated language anchors around unit-total refinement should improve recognition of normalized active-shape structure without moving belief.
entries.literal_meaning: Multiple phrases point toward the unit-total refinement pressure.
entries.candidate_intended_meaning: The kernel should recognize unit-total refinement language as structure pressure only, not as truth or certainty.

semantic_operators.legitimacy_condition: Anchor improves recognition only when used as training pressure with no belief movement.

evidence_burden: Check that active shape remains Σ|dimension_i| = 1.
Do not infer truth from language-anchor repetition.

expected_kernel_response.lexical_action: increase recognition coverage for unit-total refinement language
questions: Is this phrase pointing to unit-total structure or to force/intensity?

entries.text: Repeated language anchors around unresolved status should improve recognition of general uncertainty without collapsing it into claim non-closure or negated collusion.
entries.literal_meaning: Multiple phrases point toward general unresolved status.
entries.candidate_intended_meaning: The kernel should recognize general unresolved status as distinct from claim non-closure and negated collusion.

semantic_operators.legitimacy_condition: Anchor is valid only as recognition pressure for general unresolved status, not as closure or denial.

evidence_burden: Check whether the phrase is general uncertainty.
Check whether it instead means claim non-closure.
Check whether it instead denies collusion.

expected_kernel_response.lexical_action: increase recognition coverage for general unresolved status
questions: Is this phrase general unresolved status, or does it specify claim non-closure or negated collusion?

entries.text: Repeated language anchors around not-settled claims should improve recognition of claim non-closure without treating it as falsity or denial.
entries.literal_meaning: Multiple phrases point toward claim non-closure status.
entries.candidate_intended_meaning: The kernel should treat claim non-closure as an evidence-status condition rather than proof of falsity or proof of truth.

semantic_operators.legitimacy_condition: Anchor applies when the issue is an unsettled evidential status rather than a negated claim.

evidence_burden: Check whether the claim remains open.
Check whether evidence access is incomplete.
Do not infer falsity from non-closure.
Do not infer truth from non-closure.

expected_kernel_response.lexical_action: increase recognition coverage for claim non-closure
questions: Is this claim merely unsettled because evidence is incomplete?

entries.text: Repeated language anchors around not-collusion status should improve recognition of negated collusion without collapsing public coordination into covert agreement.
surface_terms: unless a secret agreement is shown
entries.literal_meaning: Multiple phrases point toward negated collusion status.
entries.candidate_intended_meaning: The kernel should separate public coordination from collusion unless direct covert-agreement evidence is present.

semantic_operators.legitimacy_condition: Anchor applies when the text denies collusion status while preserving the burden for direct covert-agreement evidence.

evidence_burden: Check whether a covert agreement is alleged.
Require direct link evidence before collusion status.
Do not collapse coordination into collusion.

expected_kernel_response.lexical_action: increase recognition coverage for negated collusion status
questions: Is the text denying collusion while preserving the direct-evidence burden?

entries.text: Repeated language anchors around direct-link evidence should improve recognition of when a claim needs specific evidence connecting actor, act, and alleged intent.
entries.literal_meaning: Multiple phrases point toward a direct-link evidence burden.
entries.candidate_intended_meaning: The kernel should detect when a claim needs direct evidence rather than vague association or motive language.

semantic_operators.legitimacy_condition: Anchor applies when the claim requires a specific evidential bridge between actor, action, and alleged status.

evidence_burden: Do not accept association as direct evidence.

expected_kernel_response.lexical_action: increase recognition coverage for direct-link evidence burden
questions: What direct evidence connects the actor, action, and alleged status?

entries.text: Repeated language anchors around motive and agency should improve recognition of when intent is being inferred rather than directly shown.
entries.literal_meaning: Multiple phrases point toward motive-agency pressure.
entries.candidate_intended_meaning: The kernel should distinguish motive attribution from direct evidence of action or agreement.

semantic_operators.legitimacy_condition: Anchor applies when a phrase attributes motive or intent and therefore requires support before belief movement.

evidence_burden: Check whether direct intent evidence exists.
Do not infer intent from dislike or suspicion alone.

expected_kernel_response.lexical_action: increase recognition coverage for motive and agency attribution
questions: Is intent directly shown, or only inferred from motive language?

entries.text: Repeated operator anchors around unit-total shape projection should improve recognition of semantic vectors becoming normalized active shapes.
entries.literal_meaning: Multiple phrases point toward the unit_total_shape_projection operator.
entries.candidate_intended_meaning: The kernel should recognize language that maps semantic pressure structure into normalized active shape form.

semantic_operators.legitimacy_condition: Operator anchor applies only when projection preserves Σ|dimension_i| = 1.

evidence_burden: Do not infer truth from projection.

questions: Does the projection preserve root and flattened L1 totals?

entries.text: Repeated operator anchors around anonymous shape invariance should improve recognition of structure that survives label renaming.
entries.literal_meaning: Multiple phrases point toward the anonymous_shape_invariance operator.
entries.candidate_intended_meaning: The kernel should recognize that objective-language structure must survive local label renaming.

semantic_operators.legitimacy_condition: Operator anchor applies when structure, not local label names, remains stable.

evidence_burden: Do not treat labels as truth.

expected_kernel_response.lexical_action: increase recognition coverage for anonymous shape invariance
questions: Does the structure survive local label renaming?

entries.text: Repeated operator anchors around anonymous shape repetition should improve recognition of reusable structure candidates without treating repetition as truth.
entries.literal_meaning: Multiple phrases point toward anonymous shape repetition.
entries.candidate_intended_meaning: The kernel should recognize repeated structure as reviewable structure pressure, not belief movement.

semantic_operators.legitimacy_condition: Operator anchor applies only as structure-candidate pressure and must not move belief.

evidence_burden: Do not infer truth from repetition.

expected_kernel_response.lexical_action: increase recognition coverage for anonymous shape repetition
questions: Is the repeated shape a reusable structure candidate or an over-broad collapse?

entries.text: Repeated operator anchors around force-shape separation should improve recognition that intensity changes force but not normalized shape.
entries.candidate_intended_meaning: The kernel should recognize language that changes magnitude without changing normalized active shape.

semantic_operators.legitimacy_condition: Operator anchor applies when magnitude M is separate from normalized shape i.

evidence_burden: Do not inflate shape beyond one.

questions: Is this changing force magnitude, or changing normalized shape?

entries.text: Repeated operator anchors around unresolved status should improve recognition of unresolved as a general status operator rather than a proof outcome.
entries.literal_meaning: Multiple phrases point toward the unresolved operator.
entries.candidate_intended_meaning: The kernel should recognize unresolved as a general status operator with no belief movement by itself.

semantic_operators.legitimacy_condition: Operator anchor applies when language marks an unresolved status rather than truth, falsity, or denial.

evidence_burden: Check if status is genuinely unresolved.

questions: Is this unresolved status being used as general uncertainty or as claim-specific non-closure?

entries.text: Repeated operator anchors around not-settled status should improve recognition of claim non-closure as distinct from general uncertainty.
entries.literal_meaning: Multiple phrases point toward the not_settled operator.
entries.candidate_intended_meaning: The kernel should recognize not_settled as a claim non-closure operator rather than a general uncertainty bucket.

semantic_operators.legitimacy_condition: Operator anchor applies when a claim has not reached evidential closure.

questions: Is this non-closure tied to a specific claim and evidence state?

entries.text: Repeated operator anchors around not-collusion status should improve recognition that public coordination is not collusion without direct covert-agreement evidence.
entries.literal_meaning: Multiple phrases point toward the not_collusion operator.
entries.candidate_intended_meaning: The kernel should recognize not_collusion as a negated collusion-status operator requiring role separation from coordination.

semantic_operators.legitimacy_condition: Operator anchor applies when collusion is being denied or withheld absent direct covert-agreement evidence.

evidence_burden: Require direct evidence before collusion status.

questions: Is collusion being denied because direct covert-agreement evidence is absent?

entries.text: Repeated operator anchors around coordination should improve recognition of public aligned action without upgrading it to collusion.
entries.literal_meaning: Multiple phrases point toward coordination as an operator.
entries.candidate_intended_meaning: The kernel should recognize coordination as structurally distinct from covert collusion.

semantic_operators.legitimacy_condition: Operator anchor applies when the claim is public or neutral coordination rather than covert agreement.

questions: Is the coordination public or is a covert agreement actually alleged?

entries.text: Repeated operator anchors around collusion should improve recognition that collusion requires covert-agreement burden rather than public coordination alone.
entries.literal_meaning: Multiple phrases point toward collusion as an operator requiring higher evidence burden.
entries.candidate_intended_meaning: The kernel should recognize collusion as a stronger claim than coordination and require direct support.

semantic_operators.legitimacy_condition: Operator anchor applies only when covert agreement is at issue and direct-link burden is preserved.

evidence_burden: Do not infer collusion from alignment alone.

questions: What direct evidence supports the alleged covert agreement?

entries.text: Ambiguous recurring tokens should become review targets rather than automatic doctrine or belief movement.
entries.literal_meaning: Repeated tokens can indicate useful language coverage but may also hide role collapse.
entries.candidate_intended_meaning: The kernel should grow language knowledge by surfacing ambiguous anchors for review instead of hard-promoting them.

semantic_operators.legitimacy_condition: Ambiguous token growth must be reviewed before it becomes seed pressure.

expected_kernel_response.lexical_action: surface ambiguous language anchors for review
questions: Does this repeated token preserve one role or hide multiple roles?
